title: QUIC: Support decrypting Multipath draft-07 with Path ID
description:
QUIC multipath draft-07 adds a path ID, and allows multiple
Connection IDs per path. The CID sequence numbers are unique
per path instead of per connection, and the QUIC appdata packet
number spaces are shared per Path ID instead of being separate
for each CID.

notes.body:
Sample file: [multipath-07-decrypt.pcapng](/uploads/303e5fd17a9073b168c28f83d3be5855/multipath-07-decrypt.pcapng)

As is, this breaks decryption of the older draft file in #19314. To handle it, we need to remember whether MP with or without Path ID was negotiated in order to assign the correct Path ID (0 or CID sequence number) to CIDs added by a non multipath NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame.

commits_data.title: QUIC: Handle older MP draft as well
commits_data.message:
QUIC: Handle older MP draft as well

In the older MP drafts we want to use the sequence number as the path
ID, but in the newer drafts we want to use path ID 0.
